Reminders

Write the lead times as a list. instant, 48, 24 gives you a notice the moment a request comes in, then again two days and one day before it starts. Each one clears with its own Got it.

Notices appear here and on the badge beside the Time off tab whenever the app is open on any machine. The email button opens your mail program with the message already written. Orders from the field

Submitted from the order forms on the field site. Photos and sketches ride along on the PDF the foreman emails. They are not kept here.

Reports

Export to Excel

Weekly: one tab per PO on your weekly form, a block per week. The block grows to fit however many men were on it. Job descriptions land on the Monday to Sunday lines under WORK DESCRIPTION. A Totals tab comes along.

Daily: one tab per day worked, on your Daily Time & Material form, one form per job. The crew and material sections grow to fit.

Rates

Field labor rate is what one hour of field time really costs Adman: wages plus burden. It is the price tag on every hour the shop saves the field. Shop cost comes from each man's own rate on the Crew tab, so you never set it here.

Nobody is invoiced, so there is no sell rate, overhead or profit to set. The only question this answers is: did the shop cost less than the field would have.

Field hours saved: unit ratesWhat the field would have burned on work the shop did

Read a row as "field hours saved per per unit". Wire is 2 hours per 1000 ft; an MC whip with a device is 0.616 hours each.

Health checkRun this after any setup change

Shop floor screen

Put this in kiosk mode on the computer out in the shop. The men see a keypad and nothing else: no rates, no reports, no exports. Getting back here takes the office passcode.

Sync (Supabase)

Leave these blank and everything stays in this browser. Fill them in and every machine you set up the same way shares one set of books, and nothing is lost if this computer dies.

These tables live in their own schema, so you can point this at a Supabase project you already use for something else. Nothing outside this schema is read or written. Anyone holding that project's anon key can still reach these tables, so keep the key with the shop.

Put the keys above into a copy of the app itself, then hand that copy to every iPad and computer. They connect the moment they open it, with nothing to type. Anyone who can open the page can read a built-in key out of it, so only do this for a page the shop controls.
